mapper.select: SELECT count(*) value, b. name FROM travel_scenic_view a, travel_module_detail b WHERE a.scenic_id = b.id GROUP BY b.`name`
SELECT count(*) value, b. name FROM travel_scenic_view a, travel_module_detail b WHERE a.scenic_id = b.id AND DATEDIFF(a.dates,NOW())=-1 GROUP BY b.`name`

SELECT CASE HOUR (time) WHEN 10>HOUR (time) THEN CONCAT('0', HOUR (time),':00') ELSE CONCAT( HOUR (time),':00') END name, count(*) value FROM travel_views WHERE DATE_FORMAT(time, "%Y-%m-%d") = DATE_FORMAT(now(), "%Y-%m-%d") GROUP BY CASE HOUR (time) WHEN 10>HOUR (time) THEN CONCAT('0', HOUR (time),':00') ELSE CONCAT( HOUR (time),':00') END

select (select count(*) from travel_module_detail where deleted != 1) as buildingCount, (select count(*) from travel_module_detail where deleted != 1 and is_vr = 1) as vrBuildingCount, (select count(distinct user_id) from travel_views where user_id is not null) as visitorCount, (select count(*) from travel_scenic_view where event_type = 1 or event_type is null) as scenicViewCount, (select count(*) from travel_scenic_view where event_type = 2) as recognitionCount, (select count(*) from travel_scenic_view where event_type = 3) as vrViewCount, (select ifnull(sum(likes), 0) from travel_module_detail where deleted != 1) as likeCount

select count(*) as value, b.name from travel_scenic_view a inner join travel_module_detail b on a.scenic_id = b.id where a.event_type = 2 group by a.scenic_id, b.name order by value desc limit #{limit}

select count(*) as value, b.name from travel_scenic_view a inner join travel_module_detail b on a.scenic_id = b.id where a.event_type = 3 group by a.scenic_id, b.name order by value desc limit #{limit}

select count(*) as value, b.name from travel_scenic_view a inner join travel_module_detail b on a.scenic_id = b.id where a.event_type = 1 or a.event_type is null group by a.scenic_id, b.name order by value desc limit #{limit}
select ifnull(nullif(source, ''), 'unknown') as name, count(*) as value from travel_views group by ifnull(nullif(source, ''), 'unknown') order by value desc
